crossRefs.note: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as…
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases…
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…

translations.web: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
translations.bsb: An inheritance gained quickly will not be blessed in the end.
translations.kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
translations.asv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; But the end thereof shall not be blessed.
